methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: A classification framework to estimate the required effort of ascertaining information on energy consumption of production equipment is described

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Core object is a classification framework for the effort of ascertaining energy-consumption data (framed by the authors as virtual metering point calculation); it presents no EnPI/EnB energy-performance-measurement model. ISO 50001/50006 are cited as normative context only, so EnPI/EnB is mentioned incidentally.

paper_type.evidence_quote: the developed classification framework for production equipment according to its applicability to provide information for energy monitoring is described

stage1.notes: Borderline: paper gives physical virtual-metering equations, but its core object is an effort-classification framework, not an EnPI/EnB performance model. Automotive body shop = discrete manufacturing.
